name: dim_policyholder_type_counts
sql: SELECT policyholder_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dim_policyholder_view WHERE date_format(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2015-01-01' AND date_format(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY policyholder_type ORDER BY policyholder_type
note: fixed: type is a reserved word in Athena; aliased to policyholder_type in view rebuild
